description:
Run one of Picardo’s blood-test calculators on results the user gives, and read the result against Picardo’s biomarker guide. Put each value in `inputs` by its id. Numbers are in US units unless `units` is "si". Nothing is saved.
Calculators:
- a1c, A1c to average glucose: Converts HbA1c to estimated average glucose (eAG) in mg/dL and mmol/L, or average glucose back to A1c. Optional: a1c (%), average_glucose (mg/dL or mmol/L), diabetes (no or yes).
- corrected_calcium, Corrected calcium: Total calcium adjusted for a low albumin (Payne). Needs calcium (mg/dL or mmol/L), albumin (g/dL or g/L).
- egfr, eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021): Estimated glomerular filtration rate from creatinine, age and sex, by the race-free CKD-EPI 2021 equation. Needs creatinine (mg/dL or µmol/L), age (years), sex (female or male).
- bun_creatinine_ratio, BUN/creatinine ratio: BUN divided by creatinine. Needs bun (mg/dL or mmol/L), creatinine (mg/dL or µmol/L). Optional: age (years), sex (female or male).
- homa_ir, HOMA-IR: Insulin resistance score from fasting insulin and fasting glucose. Needs insulin (µIU/mL), glucose (mg/dL or mmol/L).
- prevent, PREVENT: AHA PREVENT base model: 10-year (and to age 59, 30-year) risk of cardiovascular disease, heart attack or stroke, and heart failure. Needs sex (female or male), age (years), total_cholesterol (mg/dL or mmol/L), hdl_cholesterol (mg/dL or mmol/L), systolic_bp (mmHg), diabetes (no or yes), smoker (no or yes), bp_medicine (no or yes), statin (no or yes). Optional: egfr (mL/min/1.73 m²), creatinine (mg/dL or µmol/L), bmi (kg/m²).
- ascvd, ASCVD risk (Pooled Cohort Equations): The 2013 ACC/AHA Pooled Cohort Equations: 10-year risk of a first heart attack or stroke, for ages 40 to 79 without heart disease. Needs sex (female or male), race (white or african_american or other), age (years), total_cholesterol (mg/dL or mmol/L), hdl_cholesterol (mg/dL or mmol/L), systolic_bp (mmHg), bp_medicine (no or yes), diabetes (no or yes), smoker (no or yes).
- phenoage, Biological age (PhenoAge): Levine’s phenotypic age (PhenoAge) from age and nine routine markers: albumin, creatinine, glucose, hs-CRP, lymphocyte %, MCV, RDW, ALP and white cell count. Needs age (years), albumin (g/dL or g/L), creatinine (mg/dL or µmol/L), glucose (mg/dL or mmol/L), crp (mg/L), mcv (fL), rdw (%), alp (IU/L), wbc (×10³/µL). Optional: crp_below_detection (no or yes), lymphocytes_percent (%), lymphocytes_absolute (×10³/µL), pregnant (no or yes).
Returns the result, the equation, the guide band and what it means, the source, a picardo.health page that opens with the same result, and the Labcorp tests behind it. Pass their codes to prepare_order_link to order them. When an input is missing, the error names it and the tests that measure it.
When a PREVENT, ASCVD or PhenoAge result shows raised heart risk, `referral` names Picardo Heart, a heart scan and a cardiologist’s review. Offer it before single tests.

inputs.description: The calculator’s inputs by id. Leave out any the user hasn’t given.

a1c.description: A1c, in %. HbA1c in %. Give this or average_glucose, not both.

age.description: Age, in years. bun_creatinine_ratio: Picks the age- and sex-specific range; optional.

albumin.description: Albumin, in g/dL (g/L when units is "si"). corrected_calcium: Serum albumin from the same draw.

average_glucose.description: Average glucose, in mg/dL (mmol/L when units is "si"). Average glucose, to convert back to A1c.

bmi.description: BMI, in kg/m². Needed for heart failure risk, which needs a BMI from 18.5 to under 40.

bun.description: BUN (urea nitrogen), in mg/dL (mmol/L when units is "si"). Blood urea nitrogen. In SI units, give urea in mmol/L.

calcium.description: Calcium, in mg/dL (mmol/L when units is "si"). Total serum calcium.

creatinine.description: Creatinine, in mg/dL (µmol/L when units is "si"). egfr: Serum creatinine. prevent: Used only when eGFR is left out.

crp.description: hs-CRP, in mg/L. High-sensitivity CRP in mg/L, as Labcorp and Quest print it. If a report gives mg/dL, multiply by 10. For a result like “<0.3”, give the number and set crp_below_detection.

crp_below_detection.description: hs-CRP was below the lab’s limit (“<”). yes when the report printed hs-CRP as below a limit, such as “<0.3”; crp is then that limit.

diabetes.description: Do you have diabetes? a1c: Whether the person has diabetes. It picks which bands read the A1c; leave it out if unknown.

egfr.description: eGFR, in mL/min/1.73 m². Give eGFR or creatinine. With creatinine, eGFR is worked out by CKD-EPI 2021.

glucose.description: Fasting glucose, in mg/dL (mmol/L when units is "si"). homa_ir: Fasting glucose from the same draw. phenoage: Fasting glucose from the metabolic panel.

hdl_cholesterol.description: HDL cholesterol, in mg/dL (mmol/L when units is "si").

insulin.description: Fasting insulin, in µIU/mL. Fasting insulin in µIU/mL (the same as mU/L), in either unit system.

lymphocytes_absolute.description: Lymphocytes (absolute), in ×10³/µL. Absolute lymphocyte count, used when lymphocytes_percent is left out.

lymphocytes_percent.description: Lymphocytes, in %. Lymphocytes as % of white cells. Give this or lymphocytes_absolute.

pregnant.description: Pregnant. PhenoAge gives no result during pregnancy, which shifts several of the markers.

race.description: Race. The equations were built for white and African American adults. For anyone else the guideline says to use the white equations, which is what "other" does.

rdw.description: RDW, in %. RDW-CV in %, not RDW-SD in fL.

total_cholesterol.description: Total cholesterol, in mg/dL (mmol/L when units is "si").

wbc.description: White blood cells, in ×10³/µL. White cell count in 10³/µL, the same number as 10⁹/L.

units.description: The unit system of the numbers: "us" (mg/dL, g/dL) or "si" (mmol/L, µmol/L, g/L).

name: calculate

lastReviewed.description: When a clinician last reviewed the guide; null for a draft.

band.description: Where the result falls on the biomarker guide, or null when there is no guide or the inputs can’t pick a band.

display.description: The value as a lab would print it.

page.description: The calculator on picardo.health, opening with this result.

referral.description: Picardo Heart, when the result shows raised heart risk; offer it before single tests. Null otherwise.

title: Run a blood-test calculator
